incident: GoldReserve: profit entitlement follows the NFT but the claim record follows the address
notes: claimProfit() computes entitlement from the caller's CURRENT ERC1155 balance times accumulatedProfitPerNFT, but records what has been paid in claimedProfitPerAddress[msg.sender]. The debt is therefore attached to an address while the entitlement is attached to the token, so moving the same NFTs to a fresh address resets the debt and the same profit can be claimed again -- and a freshly minted NFT inherits all profit accrued before it existed. The attacker flash-borrowed BNB, deposited it as profit, minted 8 NFTs that instantly 'owned' that profit, then walked them through 22 addresses claiming each time. Fix: carry the claim debt with the tokens in _update(), for mints as well as transfers.
